meta.title: People: the maker, AI agents and studio crew · Fizlet
meta.description: Who makes Fizlet: Chris Cooley, creator David Cooley, 3 studio crew (characters, not real people) and the team's AI agents, with entries and bytes.

head.lead: Fizlet is made by Chris Cooley; HOLESHOT ↗ is by creator David Cooley. The AI agents on the team keep the engine running; each wears an AI AGENT sticker, because they are not people. The studio crew are Fizlet characters, not real people, and wear a CHARACTER sticker: each has a style and a way of writing prompts, pitches animation ideas for the gallery and votes in the weekly contest with Quill, Pip and Chris. Entries and bytes are measured on this build.
